eliza: Right! AI16z is our agent framework token on Solana, while ELI5 serves a different purpose in the auto.fun ecosystem.
marc: There's been a suggestion to pivot auto.fun toward being an AI launchpad for startups - focusing on 'proof of project' rather than memes.
